# Surfaces — the drill-down `SYSTEM.md` deliberately does not carry

Read `blueprint/SYSTEM.md` first; it is the index. **This file is the lookup table behind
it**, and its contents are not a guess about what might be useful: they are the six things
the previous phase measured itself having to open the tree for anyway — plus the environment
surface (§6), which a verifier showed was needed to answer them honestly.

Every section is derived from the artifact that owns it on every build — the schemas from
the schema files, the configuration from `engine.config.json` plus the resolver's own
source, the commands from each entry point's `argparse` calls, the guards from the imported
registry, the figure kinds from `_FIGURE_KINDS`, and each check's assertion from its own
docstring. Nothing here is maintained by hand.

## 1. Commands and flags — every `argparse` entry point

construct an `argparse` parser, so it covers every Python entry point and **no** `.mjs` or

## 3. Corpus guards — the contract, and what registering one costs

A guard is `run(corpus: Corpus) -> GuardResult`, defined against the result model in
`tools/corpus_check/model.py` and registered in `tools/corpus_check/guards/__init__.py`.

**Registering one costs three edits:**

1. add the import to `tools/corpus_check/guards/__init__.py`
2. add the `(GUARD, run)` pair to `GUARDS`, in the run-order position it belongs in
3. run `python3 -m tools.blueprint build` and commit the regenerated `blueprint/` files — the guard registry is part of the derived map, so a new guard makes it stale and the retained suite fails the push until it is rebuilt

> Three edits, not two. It was two until Phase 5 put the guard registry into the derived map — a verifier registered a guard with exactly the two documented edits and left the tree push-blocked, with `blueprint: STALE` on five files. The phase that invalidated the number is the phase that owes the correction.

Invariants every guard is held to:

- a finding names a line — `path:line`, or `path` with line 0 for a whole-file finding
- a guard reports `checked`, and a `floor` below which a clean run is a FAILURE, because a guard that examined nothing has not passed (`LESSONS.md` L-19)
- SKIP is never a pass — it means the guard could not run and its question is open

| # | guard | module | checks |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `register` | `tools/corpus_check/guards/register.py` | ``register`` — a register must be able to name its own rows. |
| 2 | `crossrefs` | `tools/corpus_check/guards/crossrefs.py` | ``crossrefs`` — every internal link and document reference must resolve. |
| 3 | `symbols` | `tools/corpus_check/guards/symbols.py` | ``symbols`` — a backticked identifier must exist in the source tree, or be marked planned. |
| 4 | `test-refs` | `tools/corpus_check/guards/test_refs.py` | ``test-refs`` — every cited test name and every cited **check id** must exist. |
| 5 | `counts` | `tools/corpus_check/guards/counts.py` | ``counts`` — a number a document states about the system must re-derive from the system. |
| 6 | `identity` | `tools/corpus_check/guards/identity.py` | ``identity`` — a document's version claim, checked against the bytes that would prove it. |
| 7 | `cross-doc` | `tools/corpus_check/guards/cross_doc.py` | ``cross-doc`` — when two documents enumerate the same set, the sets must match. |
| 8 | `present-tense` | `tools/corpus_check/guards/present_tense.py` | ``present-tense`` — a thing marked planned may never be described in the present tense. |
| 9 | `stamps` | `tools/corpus_check/guards/stamps.py` | ``stamps`` — a stamp whose recorded commit no longer matches the file body is invalid. |
| 10 | `built-claims` | `tools/corpus_check/guards/built_claims.py` | ``built-claims`` — a documented command must actually be runnable. |
| 11 | `rendered-output` | `tools/corpus_check/guards/rendered_output.py` | ``rendered-output`` — guards run against **built artifacts too**, not only source. |

## 4. Figure kinds

`carries_data` is what RULEBOOK L16 turns into a gate: a kind that puts a number in front of
a reader must name a resolvable source. It is declared per kind rather than inferred from the
spec class, because one spec class is shared by four structural kinds that render no quantity.
